games.name: Snack Trail
games.description: Collect bites, avoid your tail and choose moving or step-by-step play.

games.name: Skewer Sort
games.description: Move one bite at a time until every skewer holds a matching food.

games.name: Pantry Sweep
games.description: Follow the number clues, flag hidden chillies and uncover the safe pantry shelves.

games.name: Bento Sudoku
games.description: Give every food its place in a fresh or daily number puzzle, with two tray sizes.

games.name: Tray Lines
games.description: Join the dots, close the boxes and outplay the chef or a friend.

games.name: Sauce Switch
games.description: Flip neighbouring tiles and clear the tray in a fresh daily logic puzzle.

games.name: Menu Quest
games.description: Find the hidden food words. Tap the first and last letters to join them.

games.name: Tray Tactics
games.description: Capture the tray with clever food flips against the chef or a friend.

games.name: Feast 2048
games.description: Merge matching food tiles into a record-breaking feast.

games.name: Four to Feast
games.description: Outthink the house chef or challenge a friend to connect four.

games.name: Order Echo
games.description: Remember a growing order sequence across three challenge levels.

games.name: Kitchen Shuffle
games.description: Solve 3×3 and 4×4 sliding puzzles, including a daily challenge.

games.name: Food Pairs
games.description: Flip and match delicious MealDeck food icons.

games.name: Recipe Rush
games.description: Build signature meals from the right ingredients.

games.name: Kitchen Chaos
games.description: Take on the house chef in a colourful, original food-card game.

games.name: Brand Snap
games.description: Spot matching official MealDeck brand logos.

games.name: Go Dish!
games.description: Ask for food-card ranks and collect complete sets.

games.name: Full House
games.description: Find five cards forming three of one food suit and two of another.

games.name: Kitchen Stacks
games.description: Sort each food suit from one to four in a solo challenge.
